ABOUT LONGJUN

A company built onbotanical expertise.

Sichuan Longjun International Trade Co., Ltd. connects natural plant ingredients with international customers. Established in 2008, the business combines its pharmaceutical-industry heritage with an evolving aromatic raw-material portfolio.

Our founding team’s experience spans plant-derived raw materials, purification and quality management. This foundation continues to support our extracts and derivatives business, while informing the selection and supply of natural aromatic materials.

We work across ingredient sourcing, product development, supply operations and international trade. Long-term relationships with domestic trading partners and growers help connect Chinese botanical resources with customers overseas.

Built through long-term relationships

Our customer markets include North America, Europe, Oceania, East Asia and South Asia. Within China, cooperation with established import-export businesses and selected growers supports the development of our supply network.

The principles behind our work

Quality, innovation and integrity guide how we develop products and work with partners. Our aim is to combine an established raw-material business with a broader choice of botanical ingredients for international customers.
